title: Denmark Faces Post-Pharma Slowdown as Government Bets on Defence to Drive… · 24 Aug
keywords: Denmark economy, GDP slowdown, pharmaceutical exports, defence spending, anti-drone, Nordic security, Danish inflation, Terma, EU security cooperation, Danish budget 2026
notes: Denmark's economy decelerated sharply in the second quarter of 2026, exposing the risks of growth built on a single sector, as pharmaceutical output loses its earlier momentum. At the same time, the government in Copenhagen is pivoting toward a security-first agenda, ramping up defence procurement and anti-drone capabilities amid rising regional tensions. The two shifts are forcing a debate about national priorities that will define Danish politics heading into the autumn budget season.
